tasks.name: PatchPad 1.2
tasks.headline: Oracle passed 20/20 after exact checkpoint rules and independent sibling checks closed the observed false-pass paths.

blocks.title: Verifier calibration
items: Twenty binary criteria cover distinct feature and sub-feature slices with weights from 0.5 to 1.5.
Global evidence rules reject shortened markers, repeated Undo rescue attempts, unsupported alternate paths, and reasoning that omits exact observed states.
The separate-location undo criterion types three complete markers and checks exact occurrence counts after each single Undo and Redo.

blocks.title: Sibling coverage
items: Multi-caret typing requires exact MULTI insertion at three named lines followed by one atomic Undo and one Redo.
An independent multi-caret deletion sibling checks one atomic Backspace and one atomic Delete at the same three lines.
Durable fresh-client persistence and visible control discovery were retained by merging them into independent persistence and custom-editor criteria.

blocks.title: Solvability proof
items: Focused deterministic browser checks passed for complete typing groups, redo invalidation, and multi-caret Backspace/Delete.
Harbor Oracle job patchpad-oracle-v1-2-02 passed all 20 browser criteria with reward 1.0.
